title: X-Pastor Explains the Power of God

top_liked.author: @ziploc2000
top_liked.text:
My problem with the word spirituality is that I don't understand what it's supposed to mean, when I don't believe a mind can exist without a brain.
I substitute the word emotional when I hear spiritual, and it always seems to fit.

top_liked.author: @Philosophy_85
